results.title: Report: British PM Texted With Fake Trump Aide
results.description: Andy Burnham's early days as Britain's prime minister reportedly included an awkward brush with a suspected scammer. Four officials tell Politico that Burnham exchanged a handful of messages with someone pretending to be Susie Wiles, President Trump's White House chief of staff, before realizing something was off.
